notes.title: Patch 1.0.13 - Faster in the light!
notes.notes:
After seeing the depths that the deep dark corruption enjoyers can reach, a new school of thought has emerged... What about the benefits of standing Resolute, illuminating your path, and avoiding corruption? These techniques have been taught to newly arriving heroes, and the starting Foepower experience is speeding up a bit!

[h3]Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*]Corruption Resolve has been introduced to the game, and your heroes start each round Focused. While Focused, they gain a 20%(+) bonus to Foepower extraction and 20%(x) increased chance to win the roll on both regular and boss loot drops. As the hero's Corruption Resolve is reduced, the hero becomes Uneasy, then Concerned, and the benefits lessen until they are removed when corruption strikes begin.
[*]Corruption's build speed can now be modified by various things, causing your hero's corruption to speed up or slow down. Any corruption build speed change is displayed in the corruption bar. Build your heroes to use this as you will, depending on your goal for their run. 
[*]Resolute has been added as a new level up modifier, causing corruption to build up 10%(x) slower, and increasing First Wind effects (meaning both its faster charge time bonus and its duration) by 33%(+), per rank, max 3 ranks. The Resolute modifier is weighted uncommon, and Angler and Incite have been made lightly uncommon to cause the rest of the modifiers to be roughly the same weighting as before its addition.
[*]First Wind has been increased to 15%(x) faster charge times, up from 12%(x). Its base duration has increased to 30s, up from 24s. Foepower trait Long Winded increases duration by 10s per level, up from 8s. Maxed out base First Wind duration is now 60s, and grows to 120s of 30% faster charge times with 3x Resolute.
[*]Fate Shaper - now each fated mod reduces corruption resistance by 1% (down from 2%), but also increases the speed of corruption buildup by 1%. If you ever wondered what 100% faster corruption growth looks like, bring a big stack of foepower and find out!
[*]Fated modifiers - the number of mods you've Fated is shown under your hero's modifiers bar, so you can remember just how fated your hero is.
[*]Wave Surfer modifier - now adds other behaviors to the progressing 3 waves at a time, increasing the build up of corruption by 25% and accelerating deep boss pity build up for T6 legendaries by 3x. Due to Wave Surfer's deadliness to inexperienced heroes, it now appears at level 25+ and is intended for big swings at deep pushes with an established hero, rather than something to use while building the hero out.
[*]Wave Rider foepower trait now has its 3(+) HP healed after each wave doubled while you have any Corruption Resolve remaining. This results in a 30 HP heal at max ranks.
[*]The Poised Legendary Start now grants max ranks (2) of Poised, so you can build around the 90% chance for Initiative from the start. Hello, Meteorb? Overkill?
[*]Culler and Hunter have been made uncommon modifiers to enable more rolls for multiranks on regular modifiers, might want to grab them when you see them if you want their targeting behavior!
[*]Entering the deep with the portal now disables many wandering events until Wave 55, to allow you time to build up a bit of foepower for any of their trades. Wandering events are now 10% more likely after Wave 55 (still very rare, the 10%(x) increase is applied against their low base chance!).
[*]Foepowered stacks have become slightly more dangerous and interesting in deep play. Now, with every 5 corruption strikes, your hero will be temporarily Stricken, causing them to pause briefly to embrace the corruption and grow in power, and any mobs in the current wave will be similarly stricken as they recoil from this corruption surge. The duration of Stricken rises with foepowered tier, and mobs have a slightly smaller timer so they will have an opening on your hero (especially relevant in heavy CC builds). Depending on your build, your roll on avoiding the Stricken CC while the mobs get hit, your need for your react proc cooldown timer to get a bit of cooldown time while the mobs are stricken, etc etc, this may be perceived as a buff or a nerf! Good luck!
[/list]

[h3]Ability Updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Kin Seeker no longer has the 50% corruption resistance penalty, and now deals 15%(x) more damage per Foepowered tier
[*]Ice Spear has gained the debuff status effect 'Frosty'. Frosty applies a -15%(x) charge speed penalty and lasts 2.0s.
[*]Meteorb base charge speed is now 3.7s (was 3.8s) and added damage multi is now 300% (was 285%)
[*]Fireball base charge speed is now 3.1s (was 3.2s) and added damage multi is now 275% (was 260%)
[*]Heal Ability scaling increased slightly (Ability heals increase in a ratio with character level)
[*]True Light base healing is now 12-18 (was 10-16)
[*]Radiance base healing is now 5-7 (was 3-5)
[*]Lightblade base healing is now 9-12 (was 7-9)
[*]Brights base healing is now 4-6 (was 3)
[*]Metallite base healing is now 50 (was 30)
[*]Inquisitor's Lightburst react damage now scales 20%(x) per use (was 33%(x))
[*]Note these healing buffs will also increase speed of Inquisitor's Lightburst react cooldown reset from Heal Abilities
[/list]
[h3]Deep Boss Legendaries & Pity System Enhancements:[/h3]
Bringing lots of information here, because the deep boss legendary farmers are serious folk!
[list] 
[*]For a Legendary to drop, your hero must defeat a wave 75+ boss, pass its Boss Loot roll, then pass a second Legendary item roll (and then, third, it randomly selects a Legendary to offer, which is suppressed if you already have it!). It's tough RNG! The Pity system is designed to give you a little more visibility to enable more informed risk taking when seeking Legendary items.
[*]The Pity bonus now also applies 20% to the first Boss Loot roll, and remains applied at 100% to the second Legendary item roll. The Pity bonus is applied on top of a base chance for both rolls, meaning you do NOT need to have Pity to find a Legendary, just a lot of luck. 
[*]The Pity value is now shown in a vertical bar next to the hero's Gear Tray icon. This Pity bar appears after the Wave 70 Boss to encourage heroes to continue to 75+, and grows when defeating each following boss. The Pity value increases after the boss is slain, but note the Pity value shown was applied to the just-slain boss. 
[*]Once you loot a Legendary item, the Pity value is decreased significantly. However, because the Pity value is now shown, you can now make a more informed choice. Depending on your level, your hero's strength, your remaining Pity amount, your goals for the run, etc - you might decide to flee to reset Pity and go again, or continue to try to find another or just go for your deepest wave!
[*]For clarity, beyond its behavior in rerolling up to 3 times for regular loot when no loot was found, Treasure Hunter modifier helps deep boss legendary hunting in two ways: the first Boss Loot roll is weighted ~5% better per rank, and pity grows 50%(+) faster than the base per rank.
[*]Corruption Resolve double benefits - if a hero has any Corruption Resolve remaining when defeating a deep 75+ boss, the usual corruption resolve 20%/15%/10% bonus to treasure applies to the first Boss Loot roll, and then the Pity gain for defeating that boss is also doubled, so try to get to those deep bosses while your corruption resolve holds! (portal, anyone?)
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fix rare case of the game failing to spawn Wave 6 when entering the Mountain from Explore
[*]Replace a few special characters (like the circle arrow / reroll icon for Variant Path or Change Art) with images for proper display on Steam Deck
[/list]

These changes are all live now in version 1.0.13. Enjoy!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.12 - Readability & Controller Play Updates
notes.notes:
Now with improved game experience when playing on small screens or larger screens with controller - from, say, a couch!

[b]Enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Corruption Damage - show X% RESISTED under the corruption damage your hero takes, so you can better compare and understand your mitigation versus the raw corruption strike damage shown up top. Note this is probably the only place in game currently that you can see that Inquisitor specifically gets 16% innate corruption resistance!
[*]Leaderboards - add Friends filter so you can dunk on your Steam Friends with a screenshot showing your superiority (or congratulate them for their progress!)
[*]Leaderboards - add ability to scroll up in case you really need to peek at who's on top
[*]Fate Shaper - now says Cancel at top right to warn player they'll be cancelling if they haven't Confirmed their fate
[*]New Player Experience - now shows hints to Find 50 Foepower and Flee to save or invest it in town before being able to find the Mountain in Explore
[/list]

[b]UI Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*]Most action buttons are now a bit larger and easier to click (sounds easy, was a LOT of shimmying!)
[*]Action buttons no longer YELL at you (instead, Title Case) - except FLEE!
[*]Status Effects (Frozen, First Wind, Metallite, etc) have a larger, more readable name and duration/number of stacks
[*]Modifier tiles have a larger, more-readable number of ranks
[*]Character level text is much larger and now inside the experience bar
[*]All tooltips are larger and more readable
[*]Invest Foepower screen has larger trait descriptions
[*]Gear Tray equipment is bumped up 1 point, still a bit small but better than before!
[*]React READY or Cooldown remaining (e.g. 21.0s) now larger and more readable
[*]Round Footer speed run and deepest wave figures are much larger and more readable
[*]Controller / keyboard navigation reviewed throughout and minor improvements made
[*]Example controller update - Round - fix keyboard/controller nav for Show Tutorial in Explore, and allow movement up to change Art Pack
[*]Example controller update - Arena - fix keyboard/controller nav when you have a fallen hero, and when moving from the middle champion selectors to the right to Deathmatch
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Status Effects - fix reset of diminishing returns after a full loop (5 applications) to begin the countdown again immediately (was previously delayed by 1 cast after the first loop, leading to double 0% DR / full duration casts after each loop reset)
[/list]

These changes are all live now in version 1.0.12. Enjoy!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.10 - "Loot Left Behind" Left Behind!
notes.notes:
Latest foepowered updates from player feedback:
[list]
[*]At popular request, "Loot Left Behind" is no more. Now, in its place, you are tempted to RISK IT if you are fleeing and notice something shiny. Is it loot? Is it a secret new uber-rare treasure mob? Is it worth the risk of the next wave? You decide!
[*]Corruption strikes' damage range is tightened so the next wave's damage amount is a bit more predictable (note this raised the minimum strike amount as a tradeoff with the consistency, average damage balanced to be similar)
[*]Slight rebalance of Wandering Mino's damage profile - instead of two large upfront hits, they are staggered a bit - still a deadly foe!
[*]Reduced critical damage multiplier of foe heroes to 150% (from the normal 200%) as they have strong base abilities vs a player's relatively small hp pool
[*]Reduce weighting of Wave Surfer and Focuser modifiers as they are more niche build choices, now roughly 25% as likely to appear (hint: use Fate Shaper if you want to be sure to see them!)
[*]Declining Eldrin's offer now rewards you EXP for your 'wisdom'
[*]In Level Up choices, when taking a modifier that will max out your existing stack, the offered modifier ranks will flash between green and yellow to help alert you to that optimization (even if the offer is only 1 rank)
[*]Level up choices will not offer the same Ability as the last two offered for that hero. This is to help you more quickly find the Ability you are seeking and avoid Variant Path rerolls into the same choice. This resets each "round", so going back to town resets your chance to get the same Ability if you need to take that Rapido x3 instead.
[*]Bribing the nobles to take on the then-current Arena boss makes sure the newly spawned Arena boss is not one of the last three bosses encountered
[*]Performance improvement - streamlined calculations done each wave spawn to reduce chance of minor framerate drop there
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*]Fleeing from the High Inquisitor's Portal is now guaranteed to succeed
[*]Darkheart Boots now actually have their stated 100% guaranteed flee chance
[*]Deeproot Staff now exists, replacing the duplicated Minewood Staff
[*]Metal Spikes reduces damage to a minimum of 1, and damage reduction now cannot reduce from 1 to 0. Minimum damage taken is 1. (Note that a 0 damage floating text is shown if a Barrier takes the 1 damage instead.)
[*]If you somehow obtain all but 1 or 2 available level up modifiers, level ups and merchants will now allow duplicate modifier offers
[/list]

Update - minor patch 1.0.10.4 put live March 20:
[list]
[*]Added "10%(x) faster charge" to Ascension. Faster is fun!
[*]Upgraded Legendary Start's gear rewards to T6/Legendary and added Descension as a reward outcome
[*]Fix edge case in React Proc cooldown resetting from Inquisitor's healing abilities
[/list]

Update - minor patch 1.0.10.6 put live March 21:
[list]
[*]Add a bit more context in wording of Giga Unlocks to clarify their behavior before and after unlocking
[*]Variant Path now gives 25%(+) multirank chance to its rerolled set of options
[*]Variant Path now doubles the weighting effect of Fate Shaper fated mods, increasing your chance to see fated mods when using Variant Path rerolls
[*]Slight buff (~10%) to foepower gains above wave 10, Tanook wants more customers
[*]Culler & Hunter will now target the first eligible mob if there's a tie in HP or Max HP, instead of splitting between the two
[*]Show the hero's played time to max level counter at the start of the round (rather than starting with '--' until the first second ticks), and rounds now have a minimum duration of 1 second 
[/list]

Update - minor patch 1.0.10.7 put live March 22:
[list]
[*]Corruption strikes now scale slightly faster, dealing 10% more damage at corruption strike 10, 28% more damage at corruption strike 50, and 68% more damage at corruption strike 75. Note only 2% of players have achieved 10 stacks of Foepowered, which is corruption strike 50, so the increased later scaling is only a factor in very fringe cases. Tested and confirmed the achievement and leaderboard deepest clears are all repeatable with this change.
[*]Bug fix - ensure the Lodge's recruits show the proper tier icon and tooltip info for their weapon, issue was introduced with 1.0.10

These changes are all live now in version 1.0.10. Enjoy!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.9 - earliest feedback update!
notes.notes:
Its been so fun seeing folks digging in and enjoying Foepower! 

Latest updates from earliest production feedback:
[list]
[*]Add ability to Un-Flee in Adventure mode - its in the Escape->Pause screen if you change your mind!
[*]Wanderer events (like Tanook) now start appearing at wave 18, up just slightly from 16, to give you a couple more waves of foepower gain before potentially encountering them
[*]Keyboard nav - mapped WASD to match functionality of Arrow keys, better enabling left hand play with Space for Enter
[*]Treasure Hunter - added indicator at top right of loot window to show which reroll of treasure hunter hit (I, II, III)
[*]Clarify in Inquisitor's react tooltip that their Lightburst React cooldown is reduced by healing from Heal Abilities (not from other sources of healing like Leech)
[*]Expedited Insight text corrected to correctly show it gives 2%(+) to multi rank level up options, rather than 1%(+)
[*]Slightly reduced the chance for foe heroes to obtain powerful mods (like Healstone or Venomflow)
[*]After a hero's death, the free Pity Bribe option for juiced up new heroes is focused by default in the Lodge
[*]Tutorial timers set slightly longer for reading (20s total vs 18s prior), but now you can click the color progress bars to skip forward immediately
[*]Bug fix - Fleeing - the guaranteed 100% flee in Explore and immediately before Bosses was not letting you flee IF you rolled a perfect 100 flee roll. Now, even if you have perfect luck, you can get away as expected!
[*]Bug fix - foe heroes should not be able to get both Ascension and Descension anymore (yikes when they did!)
[*]Bug fix - the loot window now shows an additional and important digit of precision for the base charge speed of your current weapon for comparison (2.3s vs 2s)
[*]Bug fix - if you somehow obtain all available level up modifiers, level up windows and merchant offers will be suppressed and your character can simply continue (you can even take out your aggression on said merchant)
[*]Bug fix - in certain situations for the duration of a round, you couldn't choose to Decline an offer from The Coiled Spring or other events, but now your agency is restored and you can in fact Decline if you desire

These changes are all live now in version 1.0.9. Enjoy!

notes.title: Demo Update & Steam Next Fest Announcement
notes.notes:
Super excited to announce that Foepower will be participating in the upcoming Steam Next Fest! It runs from Feb 24 - Mar 3. The demo is already available, so feel free to jump in before the festival even starts!

The earliest demo feedback has been super helpful. The most recent round of updates from the feedback shown below. Join the discussion in the Steam Community Hub > Discussions, or hop in game and give it go!

Updates in the last two weeks:
[list]
[*]Full font update for better legibility on all screen sizes
[*]Balance pass across all monsters, including new implementation of Added Damage mob ability scaling
[*]Increase information on Ability tooltips around Base Damage, Added Damage, Crit Chance, etc
[*]Tighten up enemy UI, showing Abilities left-to-right and Modifiers above the health bar for more compact reading
[*]Tighten up UI of floating combat text, cleaner display of Lucky and Critical hits
[*]Implement Crowd Control (CC) diminishing returns for players and mobs
[*](Consecutive CCs last 20%(x) less duration each, resetting back to 100% on the 6th application)
[*]Combat now pauses when you find Loot, unless you are actively Fleeing at that moment
[*]New Leaderboard for Fastest Time to Level 30 on Warrior, so you can compete on speed as well
[*]Add Rhythmic Flow Foepower Trait - 3%(x) charge speed per rank, max 3
[*]Add Fearomones Foepower Trait - 7%(x) chance to cause panic and hesitation, max 3
[*]Buff Hunter modifier (gain 5%(+) crit chance in addition to its targeting effect)
[*]Buff Culler modifier (gain 4(+) minimum damage in addition to its targeting effect)
[*]Adjust minimum level/wave requirements for some modifiers and events (circusman), to allow for smoother and simpler low-level hero power buildup
[*]Nerf EXP gain % from Learner and Expedited Insight due to player's desire for more time in the mountain for merchants/etc
[*]Game now also saves hero progress at level up, but hero must still return to town to save their extracted Foepower!
[*]Show Mountain Found message in Explore so folks know to return to town if they've passed on entering earlier
[*]Kin Seeker damage is purple now, as it should be
[*]Added Explore hints explaining Adventure, Safety, and Kids game modes
[*]Improved keyboard/controller navigation throughout
[*]"F11" is now a quick way to toggle between Fullscreen and Windowed modes
[*]Behind-the-scenes performance improvements including strict-typing and node cleanup improvements
[*]Fixed a couple rare instability issues

Preparations in place for full game launch:
[*]Balance pass completed for Warrior, Mage, and Inquisitor classes
[*]Warrior Revenge pulled back from 33%(x) dmg reduction and charge speed to 30%(x)
[*]Improved Mage (and Mage ability) recovery via Barrier
[*]Improved Inquisitor ability recovery via Heals
[*]Inquisitors now accelerate their React cooldown recovery by using Heal abilities
[*]Inquisitor react damage now scales with consecutive uses, encouraging multi-react play
[*]Arena boss difficulty levels & arena terms balanced
[*]Arena deathmatches set to start at Arena Wave 75

These changes are all live now in version 0.9.1. Enjoy!

notes.title: Demo Update - Jan 27 2025
notes.notes:
Thanks to all the demo players - lots of improvements based on your feedback!

Updates in the last two weeks:
[list]
[*]Leaderboards have been added to the demo! How deep can your demo Warrior survive?
[*]Improved the Lodge UI, showing the then-available heroes and their modifiers & abilities
[*]Cute little oozitos have appeared in the forest, but watch out for Blue Betty
[*]New "Gear & Glory" hero popup in town to inspect hero details (gear, modifiers, abilities, dps figures, etc)
[*]Boots have gained a specific flee success chance, and your current flee chance is shown while attempting to flee
[*]Just-fallen heroes remain viewable in town until you recruit a new one - how many mods did you end up with anyway?
[*]Add new Modifier - Can Opener - so you can open a can of ... spinach... on your enemies (+ crit chance)
[*]Add new Foepower Trait - Variant Path - enabling rerolling of level up choices
[*]New Hero helper panel in town, reminding level 1 heroes of their ability to train with arena champion before starting out
[*]Giga Unlocks teaser button added, full version of game includes advanced uses for Foepower here, including "Legendary Start"
[*]Reworked the Foepower Traits UI, and added Noble Connections (improves noble bribing in the lodge)
[*]Balance pass at FP Traits costs and effectiveness
[*]Added display modes (Windowed / Windowed Max. / Fullscreen), and default to Fullscreen on 1080p or lower res monitors
[*]New encounter - The Coiled Spring - we'll see if your heroes will drink from it!
[*]New Barrier UI on the character, seen occasionally by the warrior after encountering Gavelin, or more often on mages!
[*]Buff Learner modifier & Expedited Insight trait to also grant a chance for multi-rank level ups
[*]Round pause UI is more compact, so you can pause to leisurely review your gear, hover un-familiar mobs' abilities, etc
[*]Arena damage dampening now reduces in effect over time, so if you have a perfectly matched opponent, the match will no longer be so lengthy
[*]Many other art cleanups including refreshed youthful orc, skeleton, & hungry caterpillar mobs
[*]UI updates, including new dialog UI and further polish of keyboard/controller nav

These changes are all live now in version 0.8.30. Enjoy!

notes.title: Demo Update - Jan 13 2025
notes.notes:
Many thanks to all that have tried the free demo! The feedback from the Steam community, Discord, etc has been super helpful.

Notable demo updates since launch a few days ago:
[list]
[*]The mountain’s pull has increased, and now female warriors have arrived at the lodge
[*]Add ability to find a mountain cave entrance and enter directly from the forest/explore mode
[*]First time players will need to find a mountain cave this way once, which helps prevent too-early mountain entry (and near certain death) on first goes
[*]Simplify town area names for Camp and Arena
[*]There are rumors of a new circusman wandering inside the mountain… I wonder what he has to offer…
[*]Dwarf duellers now punch with the correct amount of fingers, but surprisingly still deal significant damage
[/list]
These changes are live now in version 0.8.3. Enjoy!
